preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 10 contains the second tablet account, the priestly election of Levi, and the great heart-circumcision passage (vv. 12–22). 4QDeutˡ preserves vv. 12–15. 4QDeutʲ attests vv. 12–11:21 as part of its Shema-prefixed liturgical anthology. The chapter is well attested.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The 'circumcise the foreskin of your heart' language (v. 16, cited at Rom 2:29) tracks MT.
preamble.scroll_condition: 4QDeutˡ and 4QDeutʲ together cover most of the climactic vv. 12–22.

variant_notes: The five-fold call ('to fear, to walk, to love, to serve, to keep') tracks MT.
'Circumcise then the foreskin of your heart' tracks MT. Cited at Rom 2:29 and echoed at Col 2:11.
The 'God of gods and Lord of lords' formulation tracks MT. Echoed at 1 Tim 6:15 and Rev 17:14, 19:16.
